name: sii-27b-bench
description: Throughput/utilization sweep for SII-Decision-27B on one 8xH100 node: 8 replicas at batch 1/8k and batch 2/16k padded-token budgets on an 800-row stride subset. Writes per-shard nvidia-smi profiles and an aggregate profile.json.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
V=$R/.venv-sii
mkdir -p $R/logs/qz $R/runs/qz
cd $R
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

fail=0
echo "=== b1_8x1: 8x1 batch=1 budget=8192 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-27B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/b1_8x1 \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=1 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=8192 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_27b_bench_b1_8x1.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/b1_8x1/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profiles/profile-0.json || true
echo "=== b2_8x1: 8x1 batch=2 budget=16384 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-27B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/b2_8x1 \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=2 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=16384 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_27b_bench_b2_8x1.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/b2_8x1/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profiles/profile-1.json || true
"$V/bin/python" -I $R/harness/sii_gpu_eval.py --merge-profiles $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profiles --output $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profile.json
cat $R/runs/qz/sii_27b_bench/profile.json > $R/logs/qz/sii_27b_bench_summary.json
[ $fail -eq 0 ] || echo "one or more benchmark configs failed"
exit $fail
